title: Liberia Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Observed rainfall impacts in 2020; flood exposure and climate projections through 2050 and 2064
methodology: CCDR combines climate-risk assessment with development analysis and climate scenarios.
limitations: Detailed flood assessment is available only for Greater Monrovia; national baseline climate-hazard data are limited.

title: Liberia’s Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0): Liberia’s 2035 Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Republic of Liberia; submitted to the UNFCCC
methodology: Government NDC summarizes national vulnerability and planned sector adaptation targets.
limitations: Targets describe intended actions, not evaluated implementation or outcomes.

title: Greater Monrovia Urban Review: A Spatial Analysis Investigating Constraints and Opportunities
temporal_coverage: Spatial and service data mainly from 2008–2020; report version 2020.
methodology: Spatial analysis of informal land use, urban services, household data and flood hazards using GIS and community mapping.
limitations: Baseline data are mostly from 2008–2019; Greater Monrovia findings are not nationally representative.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Liberia
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), Global Information and Early Warning System
temporal_coverage: 2025 rainy season and harvest; food-security estimate October–December 2025; forecast June–August 2026.
methodology: FAO country brief using cereal-balance, satellite crop-monitoring and food-security data.
limitations: This brief predates later season-specific verification.

title: Peacebuilding, Reconciliation, and Social Cohesion Project
geographic_coverage: Tewor District, Grand Cape Mount County
temporal_coverage: Project period 15 January 2020–31 December 2024; listed local achievements through 2023.
methodology: Official UNDP project summary and reported activities and achievements.
limitations: Project webpage is not an independent evaluation; achievements are reported by the implementer.

title: USD 103.9M SARTLA Project Launched to Strengthen Liberia’s Climate Resilience
temporal_coverage: SARTLA project period 2025–2030; launch reported May 2026.
methodology: UNDP launch release describing project scope and reproducing government and partner statements.
limitations: County risk descriptions are official remarks, not a measured local hazard survey; project aims are not outcomes.

title: Environmental and Social Impact Assessment for the Monrovia Metropolitan Climate Resilience Project
organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Liberia; Environmental Protection Agency of Liberia
geographic_coverage: West Point community, Monrovia Metropolitan Area
temporal_coverage: Project assessment page published March 2026; project phases not dated in the page excerpt.
methodology: UNDP publication-page summary of a project environmental and social risk assessment and management plan.
limitations: The linked 33 MB ESIA PDF exceeded the reader limit; claims are restricted to the official page summary.
